card.name: Partway through dosing-instruction words
card.fires_on: Fires on the first or middle piece of a longer word in dosing and preparation instructions, such as Dose, Transdermal, reconstitute, diluent, Precautions, premedication, Dosage. The word is usually still unfinished at the marked point.

modes.label: Split dose and dosage words
modes.description: The first part of Dose, Dosage or Transdermal inside dosing text.
modes.example: Add 3 milliliters to the Morning<< D>>ose to fill (prime) the intestinal

modes.label: Split preparation words
modes.description: The start of reconstitute, diluent or premedication in preparation and premedication steps.
modes.example: to<< re>>constitute each vial by slowly

modes.label: Split section-title words
modes.description: Part of Precautions or Dosage in cross-references.

card.writes: It lowers the odds of adjust or adjustment wording, so the text is not steered toward dose-change language.
card.plain: It fires on the opening pieces of long dosing and preparation words, before the word is complete.
